title: env_variable.v1
description: One environment variable the product's code reads (principle #23), declared with the detailed design. Stored as a fenced ```yaml env_variable block in qf.yaml paths.env_variables_file; this schema validates one block. That a name is declared once is a rule of check_detailed_design_contract_gate; that every variable the code reads is declared, every declared one is read and every required one has a passing test naming it with @env are rules of check_env_config_gate.

name.description: The variable's name, as the code reads it.

required.description: true: the software stops at start-up when it is missing or invalid, and a unit test shows it.

example.description: A value that works, never a real secret.

valid.description: The values it accepts, and what happens when it is unset if it is optional.
